outputs.explanation: The spatial expression panels are heatmap-style visualizations of mRNA abundance overlaid on tissue sections; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points. The H&E image is a micrograph, not a plot.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope micrographs, not plots showing averaged data, so the check does not apply.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot where each point represents an individual patient tumor sample (n=500 LUSC, n=512 LUAD), with median and 95% CI overlaid. Individual data points are already fully displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each of the four experimental groups (n=3 technical replicates each).
